structured_input.history: Rice field, uncertain snake, local bite marks
structured_input.examination: No ptosis, no bleeding, 20WBCT clots normally

samples.draft_output:
CC: Snakebite to left foot ~2 hours ago.
HPC: Bite while working in rice field. Snake not clearly identified. No systemic symptoms yet.
O/E: Two fang marks local swelling only. No ptosis, fasciculations, or bleeding diathesis. 20-minute whole blood clotting test: clots normally.
Impression: Probable dry bite / no current envenomation.
Plan: Observe minimum 24 hours with serial neurovital checks. Wound care. Tetanus prophylaxis if indicated. Return immediately if ptosis, bleeding, or neuro symptoms.
